speaker: Doctor
text:
Good morning, I understand you're experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever after your recent treatment for sinusitis. To help me pinpoint the issue, have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as blood, cloudiness, or a foul odor?

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis; Bacterial_Urine_Culture
REQUEST TEST: CBC (Complete Blood Count)

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: I understand your urgency; given your history of antibiotic allergy (rash with amoxicillin), please confirm: are you currently experiencing chills, nausea, or visible blood in your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since you have no dysuria or hematuria, have you noticed any swelling around your eyes or ankle, or do you have a history of kidney stones?

REQUEST TEST: Serum_Creatinine
REQUEST IMAGES: Renal_Ultrasound

speaker: Doctor
text: With normal creatinine and an unremarkable renal ultrasound, and given your recent antibiotic exposure, I need to know if you have developed a new rash or hives, or if you have any joint pain, as this could suggest a drug-induced reaction or serum sickness rather than a kidney infection. REQUEST TEST: Eosinophil_Count

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Serum Sickness-like Reaction (Drug-Induced Hypersensitivity)
